compatibilityReview.reviewer: DOC-029 independent walkthrough agents (one per article group, independent of the source-review authors)
compatibilityReview.summary: DOC-029 re-verified the suite against labs built from 3fa407e3. Each article received a source review, then an independent agent walkthrough for every required role and method on that build. Articles whose walkthrough did not pass keep their earlier evidence and do not receive credit.
